changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'IssueField') BEGIN create table [dbo].[IssueField] ( [ID] bigint identity(1, 1) NOT NULL, [IssueID] int NOT NULL, [FieldTypeID] int NOT NULL, [Value] sql_variant NOT NULL, [LongText] nvarchar(max) NULL, constraint PK_IssueField primary key clustered ( [ID] asc ) ) END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_IssueField_Primary') begin create unique nonclustered index [IX_IssueField_Primary] ON [dbo].[IssueField] ( IssueID ASC, FieldTypeID ASC, [Value] ASC ) end
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_IssueField_Secondary') begin create nonclustered index [IX_IssueField_Secondary] ON [dbo].[IssueField] ( IssueID ASC, FieldTypeID ASC ) end
